# rmo_2000_3

Suppose $(x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ is a nonincreasing sequence of positive real
numbers, and for all $N$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^N \frac{x_{i^2}}{i} \le 1.$$

Show that for all $k$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^k \frac{x_i}{i} \le 3.$$
challenge:
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Nat

open Finset

theorem rmo_2000_3
  (x : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
  (hmono : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1))
  (hsq : ∀ N, (Ico 1 (N + 1)).sum (fun i => x (i * i) / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
  sorry
